policy: images, annotations and weights are not committed; raw files stay local; most restrictive applicable licence is applied

sources.name: UAVDB
sources.content: 18061 boxes, 1 per frame, 4 flights x 22 static ground cameras, one hexacopter, mostly sky; official split = cameras inside the same flights
sources.use: up to 100 frames per camera from 17 cameras; official test cameras d2c0,d3c4,d4c0,d4c6 not extracted; flight d1 -> validation, d2-d4 -> train

sources.name: Anti-UAV300 (visible)
sources.license_declared: MIT for project/code; no separate image licence
sources.content: 318 visible videos 1920x1080, 37 sessions on 2 days, PTZ tracker camera at one urban site (target centred, OSD overlay), ~13 night sessions
sources.use: every 100th frame of official train/val clips (official train/val share sessions); official test (10 sessions) sealed, not decoded; 2019-09-25 -> train, 2019-09-26 -> validation

sources.name: UAV-CB
sources.content: 3393 visible frames 1920x1080, one DJI Matrice 350/4E per frame, camouflage backgrounds (building, cloud, ground, powerline, vegetation), one PTZ camera at one site, 2025-06-23/27
sources.use: validation only, whole set (one new site, not split)

sources.name: Visual drone detection (Roboflow export)
sources.license_declared: CC-BY-4.0 on Zenodo; data.yaml says 'license: Private'
sources.content: 2145 images stretched to 640x640 but only 717 unique originals (copies across official train/valid/test), one school site, DJI footage, almost all drones >=30 px, at least one shifted box

sources.name: Cranfield synthetic (multi_drone_no_birds_40m_small)
sources.content: 749 synthetic 1920x1080 images, ~6 drones per image; masks fragmented
sources.use: statistics only, not used for training (synthetic, fragmented masks); other zips 4-7.6 GB not downloaded

sources.name: Halmstad Drone-detection-dataset (visible bird/airplane/helicopter)
sources.license_declared: CC0-1.0 (own recordings); YouTube-sourced clips belong to uploaders
sources.license_applied: CC0 for own recordings; YouTube clips eval only
sources.use: negatives only; split from Stage 6.4 split_summary.json groups; 6.4 sealed-test groups dropped (98 frames); YouTube -> eval_only

sources.name: DUT Anti-UAV detection val shard
sources.license_applied: Apache-2.0 per primary repo, no separate image licence (Stage 6.3)

sources.name: pathikg/drone-detection-dataset (baseline training data)
sources.use: 500 images replay in train, 300 other images forgetting check (eval_only; not a generalisation set)
